{{Top}}
[[File:Serroco_battle_group.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']] with [[Battle Group Serroco]].]]
{{Quote|As long as there have been space fleets, there have been ships designed as command ships, specially armed and armored to serve as symbols of a civilization's power and prestige. Command by warlords or generals, they have often turned the tide of battles.|Description of the history of command ships|<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Command ships''' or '''command cruisers''' were [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] used to command large fleets in battle.

==Characteristics==
Usually very large [[Warship/Legends|warships]], they could command dozens of smaller warships<ref name="SWKOTOR">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]]</ref> and thousands of even smaller ships.
The traditional command ships were usually constructed as the largest and most heavily armed and armored warships of a given fleet, meant to epitomize the wealth and resources available to a given civilization.<ref name="DESB" />

==History==
{{Quote|I told you to remain on the command ship.|Palpatine to Darth Vader|<ref name="Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
[[File:Eclipse_Allegiance.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']] with escorting [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].]]
A command cruiser was a type of command ship. This designation was used for the [[Maelstrom (Maelstrom-class)/Legends|''Maelstrom'']], the flagship of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] warships led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="LFRPG">[[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']]</ref>

Other examples of large command ships were the [[Republic command ship]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="TOTJ:TSW">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''</ref> the [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="SWKOTOR" /> the [[Mandator II-class Star Dreadnaught/Legends|''Mandator II''-class]] of the Clone Wars,<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class]]<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> and [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="DESB" /> the [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class]]<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> and the [[Kor Chokk]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TNJOSB">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Most classes of warship could be used for command purposes if they were equipped with the necessary facilities. Smaller [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and similar warships in both the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Fel Empire|New Galactic Empire]] were often used by higher officers as their respective command ships, most notably the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] by [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] by [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]],<ref name="TT">''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''</ref> the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]<ref name="LOTF">''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]''</ref> and the [[Imperious (Pellaeon-class)|''Imperious'']] by Grand Admiral [[Morlish Veed]].<ref name="SW:L">''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''</ref>
